Definition: properly, standing (extant), i.e. by implication, a living thing
BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, yᵉqûwm means a living thing. In Genesis 7:4, every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth, and it appears again in Deuteronomy 11:6.
TheologicalSignificance: Every living substance is wiped from the earth, and I hold that yᵉqûwm shows the flood reaching everything that breathes.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
